instruction: Add a new built-in CLI command flask config that prints the loaded application's configuration as JSON, masking the values of any key containing SECRET, PASSWORD, TOKEN or KEY as "***". It must appear in flask --help, be covered by a test, and be documented alongside the other built-in commands.

+Show the Configuration
+-----------------------
+
+To show the loaded application's configuration, use the :func:`config <cli.config_command>` command. Configuration keys containing ``SECRET``, ``PASSWORD``, ``TOKEN``, or ``KEY`` will have their values masked as ``***``. ::
+
+    $ flask config
+    {
+      "DEBUG": false,
+      "ENV": "production",
+      "SECRET_KEY": "***",
+      "TESTING": false
+    }
+
+
 Open a Shell
 ------------
 
diff --git a/src/flask/cli.py b/src/flask/cli.py
index ed11f25..9e2afe5 100644
--- a/src/flask/cli.py
+++ b/src/flask/cli.py
@@ -594,6 +594,7 @@ class FlaskGroup(AppGroup):
             self.add_command(run_command)
             self.add_command(shell_command)
             self.add_command(routes_command)
+            self.add_command(config_command)
 
         self._loaded_plugin_commands = False
 
@@ -1053,6 +1054,23 @@ def shell_command() -> None:
     code.interact(banner=banner, local=ctx)
 
 
+@click.command("config", short_help="Show the app config.")
+@with_appcontext
+def config_command() -> None:
+    """Show the app config."""
+    import json
+
+    # convert dict or sort items
+    config = {}
+    for key in sorted(current_app.config.keys()):
+        value = current_app.config[key]
+        if any(token in key.upper() for token in ("SECRET", "PASSWORD", "TOKEN", "KEY")):
+            value = "***"
+        config[key] = value
+
+    click.echo(json.dumps(config, indent=2, default=str))
+
+
 @click.command("routes", short_help="Show the routes for the app.")
 @click.option(
     "--sort",
diff --git a/tests/test_cli.py b/tests/test_cli.py
index e254c1d..26d2a91 100644
--- a/tests/test_cli.py
+++ b/tests/test_cli.py
@@ -38,6 +38,27 @@ def runner():
     return CliRunner()
 
 
+def test_config_command(runner, app):
+    app.config["SECRET_KEY"] = "super-secret"
+    app.config["TESTING"] = True
+    app.config["DB_PASSWORD"] = "password123"
+    app.config["API_TOKEN"] = "token123"
+    app.config["MY_KEY"] = "key123"
+    app.config["NORMAL_VAR"] = "hello"
+
+    cli = FlaskGroup(create_app=lambda: app)
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["config"])
+    assert result.exit_code == 0
+    import json
+    data = json.loads(result.output)
+    assert data["SECRET_KEY"] == "***"
+    assert data["DB_PASSWORD"] == "***"
+    assert data["API_TOKEN"] == "***"
+    assert data["MY_KEY"] == "***"
+    assert data["TESTING"] is True
+    assert data["NORMAL_VAR"] == "hello"
+
+
 def test_cli_name(test_apps):
     """Make sure the CLI object's name is the app's name and not the app itself"""
     from cliapp.app import testapp
